name: netplan: 固定IPを書き込んで適用
author: example
description: ログイン済みのUbuntuで /etc/netplan/99-static.yaml を作成し、netplan apply します。
text:
sudo tee /etc/netplan/99-static.yaml >/dev/null <<'EOF'
network:
  version: 2
  ethernets:
    {{iface}}:
      dhcp4: false
      addresses: [{{ip|withprefix}}]
      routes:
        - to: default
          via: {{gateway ?? ip|host:1}}
      nameservers:
        addresses: [{{dns}}]
EOF
sudo chmod 600 /etc/netplan/99-static.yaml
sudo netplan apply
